entries.translation_en: Did you hear the rumors about<LINE>the Snow Queen mask in the drama<LINE>room? They say whoever wears it<PAGE>is cursed to die on stage...<LINE>It's so terrifying!
The principal has locked all the<LINE>school gates! Nobody can leave<LINE>St. Hermelin High until the<PAGE>demon crisis is resolved. What<LINE>are we going to do?!
Welcome to the school infirmary.<LINE>Let me tend to your wounds<LINE>before you head back out into<PAGE>the hallways. Please stay safe<LINE>out there.
The library is quiet... but I<LINE>can hear strange whispers from<LINE>the old folklore section. Be<PAGE>careful around the occult<LINE>books.<CLOSE>
SEBEC's security forces have<LINE>sealed off the downtown<LINE>district! They claim it's an<PAGE>industrial accident, but we all<LINE>saw the dimensional portal!
I heard Maki Sonomura has been<LINE>hospitalized for months at<LINE>Mikage General... Her mother<PAGE>works as a chief engineer at<LINE>SEBEC, doesn't she?
The Mikage Ruins have suddenly<LINE>appeared near the shrine!<LINE>Ancient demons are pouring out<PAGE>of the subterranean depths!
Welcome to the Velvet Room,<LINE>traveler. Here, we assist with<LINE>the fusion and creation of new<PAGE>Personas. The possibilities of<LINE>the soul are limitless.
Takahisa Kandori has taken<LINE>control of the Deva System. He<LINE>intends to overwrite our reality<PAGE>with a world of his own design!<LINE>You must stop him at all costs!
The Snow Queen's ice is<LINE>spreading across the campus! If<LINE>we don't destroy the three<PAGE>cursed mirrors in the towers,<LINE>the whole school will freeze<LINE>forever!
Hypnos Tower... Nemesis Tower...<LINE>Thanatos Tower... Each tower is<LINE>guarded by a manifestation of<PAGE>human regret and sorrow. Steel<LINE>your resolve, Persona users!
